properties.name: Strait of Hormuz
properties.significance: World's most important oil chokepoint; ~20-21 mbd of crude and products plus large LNG volumes pass between the Persian Gulf and the Gulf of Oman.

properties.name: Strait of Malacca
properties.significance: Primary shipping channel between the Indian and Pacific Oceans; key route for Middle East oil to East Asia and overall Asia-Europe trade.

properties.name: Suez Canal
properties.significance: Connects the Mediterranean and Red Seas; ~12% of global trade and a major oil/LNG and container route between Europe and Asia.

properties.name: Bab-el-Mandeb
properties.significance: Links the Red Sea and Gulf of Aden; gateway to/from the Suez Canal and a strategic chokepoint exposed to regional conflict.

properties.name: Panama Canal
properties.significance: Connects the Atlantic and Pacific Oceans; vital for US east coast-Asia trade, LPG/LNG and container shipping.

properties.name: Bosphorus / Turkish Straits
properties.significance: Only sea route between the Black Sea and the Mediterranean; key for Russian, Caspian and Black Sea oil and grain exports.

properties.name: Strait of Gibraltar
properties.significance: Only natural entrance between the Atlantic Ocean and the Mediterranean Sea; heavy commercial and naval traffic.

properties.name: Danish Straits
properties.significance: Series of channels linking the Baltic Sea to the North Sea; primary export route for Russian Baltic crude.

properties.name: Cape of Good Hope
properties.significance: Alternative to the Suez Canal around southern Africa; traffic rises sharply when the Red Sea/Suez route is disrupted.

properties.name: Taiwan Strait
properties.significance: Major north-south shipping lane off China and Taiwan; a large share of world container traffic transits it, and a key geopolitical flashpoint.

properties.name: Sunda Strait
properties.significance: Connects the Java Sea and Indian Ocean between Java and Sumatra; alternative route to the Malacca Strait.

properties.name: Lombok Strait
properties.significance: Deep-water passage between Bali and Lombok; favored by large vessels and as a Malacca alternative for Australia-East Asia trade.
